images.prompt: Photorealistic split-screen vertical fashion editorial image, divided exactly in half by a clean straight vertical seam at the center. The top 26 percent of the whole image is empty plain background on both halves. LEFT HALF: a flat lay product photograph viewed from directly above on a light ivory plaster background, no person, items only in the lower 74 percent, neatly arranged top to bottom with small gaps: a chunky white ribbed knit beanie and small silver hoop earrings at the top, a hip-length warm brown faux fur coat with a soft shaggy texture laid open, a small flat black leather crossbody bag with a thin long strap, slim straight black wool trousers, black leather ankle boots with a low block heel at the bottom. RIGHT HALF: a full-body street style photo of a slim young Korean woman in her 20s wearing exactly the same items: the chunky white ribbed knit beanie, the hip-length brown faux fur coat worn open, the small black crossbody bag worn across the body with the strap over the coat, slim straight black trousers, black ankle boots, walking through a bright modern airport terminal with soft blurred background, only in the lower 74 percent. Her head is turned fully away from the camera looking back over her shoulder so only the back of the white beanie and long dark hair are visible, the face is NOT visible at all, no eyes, no nose, no mouth. Identical items in both halves, realistic fabric textures, soft cool morning window light, 35mm film look. No text, no letters, no logos, no brand marks, no signs.
